headline: US Federal Court Convicts Huawei for Deceiving Banks on Iran Deals
summary: A US court convicted Chinese telecommunications equipment maker Huawei of deceiving financial institutions regarding its business operations in Iran. US authorities have cited national security risks associated with the firm.
why: Huawei Technologies is one of the world's largest telecommunications equipment suppliers and technology providers.

impacts.name: Huawei Technologies
impacts.why: Huawei was convicted by a US court for deceiving banks about Iran dealings.
